name: Mastery
description: Earned proficiency that grows from completed play rather than level-up points or currency. Each track declares XP thresholds, optional specialization gating, named per-rank modifiers, and event sources with scalar payload matches and a stable dedupe key. It listens to completed abilities, defeats, quests, and elite encounters; rejected or duplicate facts grant nothing. One fact may credit multiple matching tracks, but never the same track twice. Ranks derive from restored XP rather than a second authoritative rank table, while initialCreditIds prevents reload farming. Mastery publishes bonuses and rank state for loadout gates and stat owners; it does not grant character XP, choose loot, purchase skills, or reset through an ordinary Build Respec. combat.bossEncounterCompleted is also a supported source, using its stable completionId for once-only encounter mastery. Boss XP and drops still consume the ordinary entityDefeated independently; this completion source is optional and cannot synthesize either.

inputs.name: tracks
inputs.description: Definitions: [{id, name, specialization?, thresholds, effectByRank?, sources}]. thresholds are strictly increasing XP values. effectByRank contains one named-modifier object per threshold. A specialization-gated track credits only while that identity is active.

inputs.name: sources
inputs.description: Optional shared source definitions inherited by tracks that do not declare their own. Each source is {event, match?, amount?, amountFrom?, dedupeBy}; amount defaults to 1 when neither amount field is present, and dedupeBy names a stable payload field such as castId, defeatId, completionId, or questCompletionId.

inputs.name: initialXp
inputs.description: Restored XP by track id. Current ranks and bonuses derive from these values and current thresholds; restoration emits neither XP nor rank-up events.

inputs.name: initialCreditIds
inputs.description: Restored credit keys in track:sourceEvent:stableId form. A restored or subsequently repeated key is a no-op, preventing duplicate event delivery and reload from granting mastery twice.

outputs.name: xpByTrack
outputs.description: Current earned mastery XP per track; the state initialXp restores.

outputs.name: ranks
outputs.description: Derived rank per track. Zero means the first threshold has not been reached.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.description: Per-track current rank, XP, next threshold, and normalized progress toward it for UI projections.

outputs.name: bonuses
outputs.description: Named effect modifiers from every achieved rank, summed by key. Applying a modifier remains with the component that owns the affected stat.

outputs.name: creditIds
outputs.description: Durable dedupe ledger in the same form initialCreditIds accepts.

outputs.name: lastRejected
outputs.description: The last malformed, inactive-track, unmatched, or duplicate credit and its reason, without changing XP.

provenance: Specialization and mastery pass searched mastery, proficiency, Skills Tree, Upgrade Tree, Achievement Milestones, Run Meta Progression, XP Leveling, and Prestige Reset. Skills Tree spends level-earned points, Upgrade Tree spends currency, Achievement Milestones fires once-only achievements, Run Meta Progression owns between-run unlock pools, and XP Leveling owns character levels. None owns multiple restorable proficiency tracks driven by deduplicated gameplay facts. This is not character XP, a skill-point tree, an achievement ledger, loot, or a prestige reset.
